text:
SY207
Social Theory I
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
An introduction to the
major
theories of sociology, including the classics, which deal with such issues as capitalism, industrialism and urbanism. Emphasis will be placed on the social context of theory, the assumptions underlying theory and the critical evaluation of theories.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY101
or
SY103
Exclusions
SY203*.
